meta.title: 网页助手
meta.description: Let the assistant read and operate already-open, signed-in Desktop pages in the current session. Lists visible tabs, reads paginated text and executes JavaScript to query DOM, click, fill or scroll. Keep the target page visible and ask for the task. Scripts run in the page context without added Node/Electron access. Timeouts do not undo effects; never automatically retry. Cross-origin frames, canvas/PDF content and unloaded text may be unavailable.
